analysis.title: Analysis
items: Status: You are in a normal recovery stage.
Medical follow-up: Your current condition looks fine.

reassuring.title: Reassuring signs
items: Swelling is expected for 3-7 days after laser treatment.
Bruising darkens first and then fades naturally. (This is normal.)
Mild redness can last for 1-2 weeks.

lifestyle.title: Daily care that helps recovery
items: Apply a cold compress 3-4 times a day, 15 minutes each. (First 48 hours)
Keep your face clean and avoid makeup for 3-5 days.
Wear SPF 50+ sunscreen whenever you go outside.
Avoid intense exercise for one week.

redFlags.title: Warning signs
items: Swelling that increases sharply after day 3
